log: note 'WIP 06 (target lever works; target short FAILS on purpose): the module before the lockout. Power the input block @IN (lever @L) to open: clear 28 ticks after, solid 13 after the lever goes off. An open request of 20 ticks (target short) re-closes during the open sequence and the door sticks with the center cell empty. The library door (examples/circuits/door_3x3) adds a lockout repeater that fixes it.'

label L 8 3 9 'test lever on the input block'

target new short 'FAILS on purpose: the lever on for only 20 ticks (like a stone button); expected: open, then closed by 80'
